Actual Bangor July7 02UTC manual MW1=80,1 quality-passed slight rain showers; IANA/Eastern Maine DST converts to July6 22:00 EDT, same clock as original Ellsworth newspaper claim but different site and hourly observation does not identify onset or cloudbuster effect.
Bangor manual July7 UTC04/05 quality-passed moderate/heavy showers; AA1 July7 12UTC=24h 19mm, condition9 unspecified, quality1 passed; not per-hour precipitation or independent frontal/causal proof.

Real Bangor hourly quality1 SLP drops 1015.5hPa 1953-07-06T14UTC -> 1008.8hPa 1953-07-07T02UTC (6.7hPa over 12h), during and after reported Ellsworth operation; this supplies an ordinary-weather causal alternative candidate, not verified synoptic system or proof of device effect/ineffectiveness.

NOAA Bangor WIND 200 degrees from true north at UTC14/15/16 July6 quality1, bracketing reported separate Graham Lake device operation UTC14:45–15:52; no wind directional shift detected at Bangor during this hourly interval, which does not test wind shift at Ellsworth.

Within 744 eligible quality1 12h pressure pairs ending in July1953, 46 have a drop at least as great as observed -6.7hPa; overlapping serial-dependence and mixed wet/dry means neither 46/744 nor a percentile is an intervention probability or independent empirical study.

algorithm.retraction: Any claim depending on a withdrawn source is marked reopened (not false). A claim with status unpaid remains unpaid. Unrelated independently grounded claims retain their status.
algorithm.prohibition: No edge automatically promotes author assertions or observed precipitation into device causality; model statuses are bibliographic, not ontology truth. An uploader's third-person promotional biography cannot certify Navy employment, historical device construction, or Flanagan-Gentry-Croft technical handoff.
algorithm.clock_bucket_sensitivity: If station local July 6 22h is stipulated and cutoffs are assumed to end local right-closed 24h windows, cutoff before 22h labels hypothetical rain as July 7 and cutoff at/after 22h labels July 6; without observed station clock and at-site hour neither bucket identifies Reich event.
algorithm.isd_time_nonpromotion: Original ISD 1953 station-year file existence does not imply 1953-07-06 data coverage, AA1 rainfall report, UTC-to-Maine-local converter, independent observer root, or any intervention effect. Invalid or absent payload remains unpaid, not false.
algorithm.replay_correction: Earlier parser incorrectly equated first-four ISD variable characters with complete record length, self-tests then used equally defective synthetic fixture; all prior claimed source format playback requires corrected 105+variable invariant. Executed corrected fixtures do not pay original 1953 bytes or event-hour chronology.
algorithm.original_hour_crosslink: Source content moved from unpaid to observed for converted 1953 Bangor CSV, but publisher-signed original S3 custody, original fixed-width ISD gzip, original Ellsworth site and no-cloudbuster counterfactual stay unpaid. First 22h observed rain code at Bangor is clock correspondence, not minute onset or cause.
